lead.headline: US Refueling Planes Over Middle East, GPS Jammed in Tehran — Strike Window Opens
lead.they_say: Vance says Iran deal will 'definitely be reached before midterms.' Markets price diplomacy — oil below $90, VIX below 17. Consensus believes the diplomatic off-ramp is real and Iran-Israel is contained tit-for-tat, not a full war.
lead.reality: US refueling aircraft positioned over the Middle East. GPS interference confirmed in multiple areas of Tehran. Iran's army on full combat alert. Israel declared readiness to strike Iran. The pre-strike posture is confirmed — only timing is unknown.
lead.thesis: The gap between market pricing (contained conflict, diplomatic resolution) and military signals (refueling planes, GPS jamming, combat alert) is at maximum width. If a strike hits before Asian open, oil gaps $5-8, VIX spikes above 20, gold rallies. If diplomacy wins, oil fades below $85. The bilateral is unresolved.
lead.actors: Trump, Iran Supreme National Security Council, US Central Command, VP Vance
lead.invalidation_trigger: US Confirms diplomatic breakthrough with verified Iran deal announcement. Refueling planes return to base. GPS interference ceases.
paradigm_implications: Direct US-Iran military engagement is structural, not a skirmish — the blockade resolves by military outcome
EIA demand downgrade vs supply disruption creates bilateral oil setup — asymmetric optionality
Diplomatic track running in parallel with military preparations signals US negotiating weakness
lead.capital_flow_implication: Capital on hold between equities and commodities — $5.0B commodities inflow already detected. If strike hits, capital rotates out of equities into energy, gold, vol. SPX selling accelerates.
lead.portfolio_implication: Long WTI, GLD immediately. Short SPX on escalation premium repricing if strike hits. Long VIX calls as tail. Do not short oil unilaterally — the US retaliation binary is unresolved and the first strike gaps oil $95+.

stories.headline: US Refueling Planes Over Middle East, GPS Jammed in Tehran — Strike Window Opens
stories.they_say: Vance says deal before midterms. Markets price diplomatic resolution. Oil below $90, VIX below 17 — contained conflict priced in.
stories.reality: US refueling aircraft over MEA. GPS jammed in Tehran. Iran on combat alert. Israel ready to strike Iran. Pre-strike posture confirmed.
paradigm_implications: US-Iran kinetic engagement transforms Hormuz blockade from diplomatic to military timeline
EIA revising Q3 2026 forecast — the gap between demand projection and supply disruption widens
stories.portfolio_implication: Long WTI, GLD immediately. Long VIX calls. Do not short oil — strike is binary and unresolved.

stories.headline: South Korea Commits $350B to US — Pays Protection Money for Tariff Relief
stories.they_say: Korea is investing in US industrial base as a strategic partnership. Normal trade diversification.
stories.reality: $350B is ~20% of Korea's GDP. $200B in strategic US industries, $150B shipbuilding. Protection payment for tariff escape — a template for all US allies.
paradigm_implications: Allies buying tariff relief with hard cash sets a dangerous precedent
Supertanker ordering boom mirrors 2008 — peak-cycle behavior before a glut
stories.portfolio_implication: Long Korean shipbuilders (HD Hyundai Heavy) on orderbook momentum. Short Baltic Dry forwards — glut cycle being set up.

stories.headline: Anthropic Releases Claude Fable at 2x Opus Pricing — AI Competition Accelerates
stories.they_say: Standard product segmentation. Another model release is not a catalyst.
stories.reality: Claude Fable released 'today' — earlier than any analyst expected. Premium pricing at 2x Opus. Anthropic rushing to beat OpenAI's next release.
paradigm_implications: Frontier AI accelerating faster than consensus priced
Premium enterprise AI pricing creates margin expansion narrative
stories.portfolio_implication: Long AI-crypto tokens (FET, RNDR, TAO). Long NVDA at next US equity open.

stories.headline: Strategy Resumes Bitcoin Buying Spree — Halts Market Panic at $58K Support
stories.they_say: BTC sell-off is brutal. Shorts target MSTR. Institutions capitulating.
stories.reality: Strategy (MicroStrategy) resumed buying at $58K. World's largest corporate BTC holder. Buying spree halted panic. Shorts face capitulation risk.
paradigm_implications: Corporate BTC accumulation continues despite panic — signals institutional conviction
MSTR shorts face asymmetric risk if buying spree continues
stories.portfolio_implication: Long BTC with $58K invalidation. Short MSTR puts.

stories.headline: SpaceX IPO June 12 — 2 Days Away, $1.8T Valuation, OpenAI S-1 Filed
stories.they_say: Biggest IPO in history is 2 days out. Normal market event.
stories.reality: SpaceX at $1.8T+ is 96x 2025 revenue — Q1 loss of $4.28B on $4.69B revenue. OpenAI S-1 confidential filing. Dual IPO wave defines 2026 capital markets.
paradigm_implications: AI infrastructure capex cycle ($40B/yr at SpaceX alone) is the through-line
India's Starlink block signals regulatory pushback on Musk's empire
stories.portfolio_implication: Long SPCX at IPO if pricing isn't ridiculous. Watch India block resolution as catalyst.
